# NPM Improved v1.8.0-beta.3

Firewall management and visibility improvements for the beta release.

## Firewall controls
- **Settings → Firewall:** The firewall feature defaults to enabled on supported installations. Administrators can switch it off and back on. Disabling releases the instance's managed filtering policy without modifying existing proxy hosts, streams, exposed ports, or other containers.
- **System Health → Firewall:** Live helper status, verified packet filtering, rule state, dropped packets and bytes, pending activation confirmation, and administrative enable/disable and policy-refresh controls.
- **Top-level Firewall navigation:** Appears only when the instance firewall feature is enabled; hiding it on disable does not remove the Settings control.
- **Instance firewall policy editor:** Maintains trusted CIDRs, deployment model, published-port guidance, live status, and existing safeguards.

## Safety
- Feature availability and packet-filter enforcement are separate. A new installation starts with the feature enabled but **does not silently apply default-deny packet filtering** without confirmation of management access.
- Enforcing a newly activated policy retains the two-minute confirmation and automatic rollback window.
- Re-enabling the feature preserves the configured networks and **does not automatically reactivate filtering**.
- Deactivation is shown as pending or unverified until the firewall companion confirms release of the filtering rules.
- All changes are local to the individual NPMi instance; they do not change router configuration, host firewall rules, or other containers.
- Administrator permissions and audit records apply to the master switch and policy controls.

## Compatibility
- Retains existing v1.8 beta instance firewall helper and Compose overlay.
- No database migration, new network port, or manual production-server replacement required.
- Existing backend and frontend behavior outside firewall management remains unchanged.
